description: This file manages matrix execution approval logic, including configuration resolution, approver retrieval, request matching, and approval prompt suppression within the openclaw plugin SDK.

methods.name: normalizeMatrixApproverId
methods.description: Normalizes a matrix approver ID from string or number to a standardized string or undefined.

methods.name: normalizeMatrixExecApproverId
methods.description: Normalizes an approver ID, returning undefined if the ID is '*' or normalized to undefined.

methods.name: resolveMatrixExecApprovalConfig
methods.description: Resolves the execution approval configuration for a given account, considering whether the account is enabled and configured.

methods.name: countMatrixExecApprovalEligibleAccounts
methods.description: Counts the number of eligible matrix accounts for approval based on configuration and request filters.

methods.name: matchesMatrixRequestAccount
methods.description: Determines if a request matches a specific account based on turn source channel and account ID normalization.

methods.name: getMatrixExecApprovalApprovers
methods.description: Retrieves the list of approvers for a given matrix account.

methods.name: isMatrixExecApprovalTargetRecipient
methods.description: Checks if a sender is the target recipient for matrix execution approval.

methods.name: buildFilterCheckRequest
methods.description: Builds an approval request object from reply metadata for filtering purposes.

methods.name: shouldSuppressLocalMatrixExecApprovalPrompt
methods.description: Determines whether to suppress the local approval prompt based on profile and request metadata.
